pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of National Economy and Finance**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Εθνικής Οικονομίας και Οικονομικών) is the[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))responsible for overseeing Greece's[public finances](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_finance). The current minister is[Kyriakos Pierrakakis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyriakos_Pierrakakis), a member of the[Hellenic Parliament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hellenic_Parliament)representing the[Athens A](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Athens_A)constituency for the[New Democracy party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Democracy_(Greece)).

The ministry was established in August 2023 through a renaming and reorganization of the former**Ministry of Finance**under the[Mitsotakis government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Cabinet_of_Kyriakos_Mitsotakis).
